buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Commercial Experience Eligibility Criteria: Firm should be Registered/Established for supply of Carbide Parallel shank twist drill /similar item such as Boring bar/Tools/Inserts/carbide drill bits in OFA or sister Ordnance Factories; OR Firm should have past experience of supplies of Carbide Parallel shank twist drill /similar item such as Bori ng bar/Tools/Inserts/carbide drill bits such as to other Central/ State Govt. Organizations/ PSU’s or reputed Private firms during last 7 years ending last day of the month previous to the one in which applications are invited which should be either of the following: - i. Three completed orders each costing not less than the amount equal to ₹ 34,950/- or ii. Two completed orders each costing not less than the amount equal to ₹ 46,600/- or iii. One completed order costing not less than the amount equal to ₹ 81,550/- Note: The bidder has to comply with the eligibility criteria or else their offer shall be summarily rejected. 2) The bidder should have average annual turnover of ₹ 1 lakhs during the financial year 2023-24, 2024-20 25 and 2025-26. Bidders has to submit CA certified turnover details for the financial year 2023-24, 2024-2 025 and 2025-26. 3) The supplier should provide genuine material certificate from OEM or authorised dealer/distributor of th e product during delivery of materials. Without genuine material certificate from OEM or authorised dealer/ distributor, the materials shall not be acceptable.

4) MSEs and Startup firms are exempted from experience and turnover criteria. As per the latest order issued by Ministry of MSME, if a bidder is a Micro or small Enterprise (MSE) then the bidder shall be relaxed from experience criteria & bidder turnover subject to meeting of quality and techni cal specification. The bidder seeking relaxation for experience criteria & bidder turnover shall upload the s upporting documents to prove his eligibility criteria for relaxation. 5) Scope of Supply (Bid price to include all cost components): - Supply of Goods as per Monitoring Instructi on attached. 6) Bidder must submit Monitoring Instruction attached in the bid along with their offer duly signed & stamp ed for acceptance, failing which offer may be rejected. 7) LD Clause/Force Majeure Condition/Arbitration is applicable to this bid as per GeM GTC and YILSPM-24. 8) Option Clause for 25% shall be applicable. 9) Payment Terms - 100% Payment on delivery and acceptance of material at factory premises, which can be accepted. In such cases, payment is to be made within 45 days of receipt and acceptance of materials at the factory premises along with requisite/relevant documents from suppliers. 10) There can be occasions when excess/short supplies are made by the suppliers due to various reasons. These variations in supplies may be accepted with the approval of CFA, subject to the value of such excess /short supplies not exceeding 5% (five percent) of the original value of the contract. 11) Supply orders where the GST amount shall exceed ₹ 5,000.00/- The invoices should be uploaded imme diately by the supplier in GSTR-1/FF so that the invoice appears in GSTR-2B of the branches. If not found in GSTR-2B of the branches. Payment should be withheld unless it appears in the GSTR2B of the branches. 12) All successful bidders must ensure that every service rendered or product supplied under the contract is supported by a mandatory e-invoice as per prevailing GST regulations. IGP for the products are continge nt upon the verification of said e-invoice. The purchaser reserves the right to refuse any services lacking pr oper e-invoice documentation at the supplier’s risk and cost. 13) In case of any query, feel free to contact Shri Pramod Patil, Assistant works Manager. Contact no: 0251 -616325 or email to ofapv@ord.gov.in .
